description: This source file defines utilities for copying tensors or storage objects between Python objects, including functions for attempting and performing copies with optional non-blocking and broadcasting features. It includes type definitions, a copy info struct, and functions to select and execute the appropriate copy method based on object types and copy properties.

methods.name: bool tryTHPCopy(const THPCopyList & v,PyObject * dst,PyObject * src,bool non_blocking,bool broadcast)
methods.description: Attempts to perform a copy operation based on the provided copy info list, matching 'non_blocking' and source type subtype. Returns true if a copy was successfully performed.

methods.name: bool THPCopy(const THPCopyList & v,PyObject * dst,PyObject * src,bool non_blocking,bool broadcast)
methods.description: Performs a copy operation between source and destination objects, trying primary and fallback copy strategies. Sets an error if copying is not implemented for the given types and properties.
